name: Selby C. Rains
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Dallas, Texas
education: The University of Oklahoma College of Law
about: A senior associate attorney at Lisa Newman Law, PLLC, based in Dallas, Texas, Selby C. Rains serves clients in matters concerning estate and trust administration, probate proceedings, business succession planning, entity formation and long-term wealth preservation. She collaborates with financial advisors, insurance professionals and tax experts to resolve issues and offer tailored solutions that fit their specific needs.

At Southern Methodist University, Ms. Rains secured her bachelor’s degree in international studies and Spanish literature, along with minors in psychology and human rights. She went on to complete her Juris Doctor degree from The University of Oklahoma College of Law, where she was also the note and comment editor of the American Indian Law Review.

Board-certified in estate planning and probate law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Ms. Rains has been licensed by the State Bar of Texas since 2016. She is included in the “Ones to Watch” list in trusts and estates by Best Lawyers and the “Best Lawyers in Dallas” list for trusts and estates. Her skill ranges from fundamental estate planning for smaller estates to sophisticated strategies for tax optimization, asset protection and liability mitigation on behalf of ultrahigh net worth individuals and families.

Ms. Rains is an active member of the Texas legal community and has memberships with the Dallas Estate Planning Council, the Texas Bar College, the State Bar of Texas (Real Estate, Probate and Trust Law Section) and the Dallas Bar Association (Probate, Trust and Estates Section). She has also been rated “Excellent” on Avvo.
